overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（8 篇）、风险管理与衍生品（2 篇）、国际贸易（1 篇）。方法上以模型校准、实验方法为主。来源分布：arXiv（9 篇）、NBER（3 篇）。其中 3 篇命中顶级期刊白名单。

papers.title: Moments of Random Coefficients in Short Panels
papers.abstract: We study identification and estimation of moments of random coefficients in short linear panels, allowing the number of heterogeneous coefficients to exceed the number of equations observed for each unit. Under moment homogeneity, different regressor histories impose restrictions on the same moment vector. We give necessary and sufficient conditions for these restrictions to identify moments of a given order, stated in terms of the row spaces generated by the regressor support. The results show that moments may be identified even when the coefficients cannot be recovered for any individual, and, for two full-row-rank histories, give the exact loss of independent restrictions caused by overlap of their row spaces. When the support condition fails, we establish nonidentification in the maintained model and characterize the sharp identified set implied by these conditional moments. At second order, the identified set is determined by positive-semidefinite covariance restrictions and is also sharp relative to the full joint distribution of outcomes and regressors. Under the support condition, weighted minimum-distance estimators are root-$N$ asymptotically normal; under conditional nondegeneracy, oracle generalized-inverse weighting attains the Chamberlain (1987) efficiency bound for the maintained conditional-moment model.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了在短线性面板数据中随机系数矩的识别与估计问题，这些数据允许异质系数的数量超过每个观测单元所对应的方程数量。在矩同质性的假设下，不同的回归变量历史结构会对同一个矩向量施加约束。我们给出了识别给定阶数矩的必要充分条件，这些条件是基于回归变量所生成的行空间来表述的。研究结果表明，即使无法恢复任何单个系数的具体值，矩仍然可以被识别出来；对于具有满行秩的回归变量历史结构，我们还精确地计算了由于它们的行空间重叠而导致的独立约束减少量。当支持条件不满足时，我们证明了在所维持的模型中矩无法被识别，并描述了这些条件矩所蕴含的“精确可识别集”。在二阶矩的情况下，可识别集由半正定协方差约束决定，并且相对于结果变量和回归变量的完整联合分布也是“精确可识别”的。在满足支持条件的情况下，加权最小距离估计量具有根号N的渐近正态性；在条件非退化的情况下，使用“神谕广义逆加权”方法可以达到Chamberlain（1987）提出的条件矩模型的效率界限。。

papers.title: When Can We Work in Embedding Space? What Text Embeddings Preserve
papers.abstract: When do text embeddings work as inputs to empirical analysis? Their use rests on an assumption: that we can trade text for its low-dimensional embedding, and lose little in doing so. I make that assumption precise under a generative model in which documents are mixtures of latent topics. I study two uses---clustering units in embedding space and controlling for high-dimensional text. A cluster of embeddings is a set of documents with similar topic mixtures; controlling for the embedding is equivalent to controlling for the topic mixture, so validity reduces to whether that mixture captures the confounding. In an application to 363 U.S. metropolitan areas, embedding-based clusters of LLM-generated economic descriptions recover interpretable economic archetypes and separate local employment dynamics more sharply than clustering on model residuals, or on a curated set of industry and demographic covariates.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】文本嵌入何时可以作为实证分析的输入？其使用基于一个假设：我们可以用文本的低维嵌入来替代文本本身，而这样做所损失的信息很少。我在一个生成模型框架下明确了这一假设，在该模型中，文档被视为潜在主题的混合体。我研究了两种具体应用：一是将文本嵌入用作聚类单元；二是利用文本嵌入来控制高维文本特征对分析结果的影响。一个嵌入簇指的是具有相似主题组合的文档集合；控制嵌入特征实际上等同于控制主题组合，因此分析的有效性取决于这种主题组合是否能够捕捉到潜在的混淆因素。在对美国363个大都市区的应用中，基于文本嵌入生成的聚类结果能够揭示出具有解释性的经济特征，并且比基于模型残差或精心挑选的行业及人口统计协变量进行聚类时，能够更清晰地区分不同地区的就业动态。。

papers.title: The Impact of Fiscal Policy to Promote Healthy Diets: Evidence from the Navajo Nation
papers.abstract: One of the most comprehensive fiscal policies to improve diet was adopted by the Navajo Nation; the Healthy Diné Nation Act (HDNA) of 2014-15 consists of two parts: 1) an exemption from sales tax for healthy foods and beverages; and 2) a tax increase on unhealthy foods and beverages. Together, they create a price wedge of 7-8% between healthy and unhealthy foods. We estimate difference-in-difference models and event studies that estimate the effect of the HDNA on a variety of health conditions relating to diet and weight for newborns and mothers which are recorded in birth certificate data. We find no evidence that the HDNA improved these outcomes; our estimates are precise enough to rule out improvements in gestational diabetes as large as those reported for U.S. city SSB taxes. Possible explanations for the null results include incomplete retailer implementation and cross-border shopping.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】纳瓦霍族采纳了一项旨在改善饮食的综合性财政政策——即2014-15年颁布的《健康纳瓦霍族法案》（Healthy Diné Nation Act, HDNA）。该法案包含两项主要内容：1）对健康食品和饮料免征销售税；2）提高不健康食品和饮料的税率。这两项措施共同在健康食品与不健康食品之间形成了7-8%的价格差异。我们通过差异-差异模型（difference-in-difference models）和事件研究（event studies）来评估HDNA对新生儿及母亲健康状况的影响，这些健康数据记录在出生证明中。研究结果并未显示HDNA对相关健康指标有显著改善作用；我们的估计结果足够精确，可以排除HDNA对妊娠糖尿病等健康问题的改善效果达到美国某些城市实施类似税收政策所宣称的水平。导致研究结果无效的可能原因包括零售商对政策的执行不彻底，以及消费者存在跨境购物行为。。

papers.title: CentaurBench: Benchmarking LLM Capabilities on Augmenting vs. Automating Real-World Work Tasks
papers.abstract: Most LLM benchmarks rank models on their ability to automate work tasks. In practice, however, models are often used to assist other (human or LLM) agents. The question that drives model selection is therefore not only which model produces the best output, but which model most improves the work of another (weaker) agent. We introduce a unified framework that evaluates the capability of models to automate and augment another agent's performance. Across seven economically grounded real-world tasks, an assistant model writes assistance text for a standardized lower-capacity worker model, which produces the deliverable. In automation mode, the assistant produces the output directly. Outputs are scored through blind pairwise comparisons by an LLM judge panel with task-specific rubrics, replicated across ten runs. Rankings across the two regimes are only modestly correlated, and the automation winner loses augmentation on five of seven tasks. Assistance is not reliably positive. The unaided worker outranks every assisted condition on three tasks, and only one model's guidance beats no guidance on average. These results suggest that automation ability is an incomplete proxy for assistance quality, motivating benchmarks that evaluate models according to the roles they play in human-AI and multi-agent systems.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】大多数大型语言模型（LLM）的评估标准都是基于模型自动化执行工作任务的能力。然而，在实际应用中，这些模型通常被用来辅助其他代理（无论是人类还是其他LLM）。因此，选择模型的关键问题不仅在于哪个模型能够产生最佳的结果，更在于哪个模型能够最大程度地提升另一个（能力较弱的）代理的工作效率。我们提出了一个统一的评估框架，用于衡量模型在自动化和辅助其他代理性能方面的能力。在七个基于现实经济场景的任务中，辅助模型会为标准化的、能力较低的工作者模型生成辅助文本，后者最终生成最终成果。在自动化模式下，辅助模型会直接生成输出结果。评估过程由一个由LLM专家组成的评审小组通过针对具体任务的评分标准进行盲法对比，该过程重复进行了十次。结果显示，在这两种模式下模型的排名相关性较低；在七个任务中，自动化模型在五个任务上的表现不如辅助模型。辅助作用并不总是积极的：在三个任务中，未接受辅助的工作者模型的表现优于所有接受辅助的模型组合；平均而言，只有一种模型的辅助效果优于完全不接受辅助的情况。这些结果表明，自动化能力并不能完全反映辅助效果的质量，因此有必要开发新的评估标准，根据模型在人机交互和多代理系统中的实际...。

papers.title: Agentic Quantitative Trading: A Survey of Workflows, Systems, and Evaluation
papers.abstract: Quantitative trading is moving from isolated predictive models toward agentic workflows that combine reasoning, tool use, memory, and feedback. This survey reviews agentic quantitative trading across five stages: factor mining, signal discovery, portfolio construction, order execution, and risk management. We further examine agentic quant trading systems through architecture, coordination, and adaptation, while comparing benchmarks across strategy construction, offline trading, live market evaluation, and reliability assessment. Our review finds that current systems remain concentrated on signal discovery, while complete integration with portfolio construction, execution, and risk control is still uncommon. Multi-agent systems also rely heavily on aggregation despite increasingly diverse workflow structures. Benchmark evidence further shows that strong model or forecasting capability does not reliably translate into trading performance under live market conditions and reliability controls. We conclude with future directions for more complete trading workflows, stronger coordination, and evaluation matched to the capability being assessed.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】量化交易正从基于孤立预测模型的方法，逐步发展为能够整合推理、工具使用、记忆功能及反馈机制的自动化工作流程。本文综述了量化交易系统的五个关键阶段：因子挖掘、信号发现、投资组合构建、订单执行和风险管理。我们进一步从系统架构、协调机制及适应性三个方面对这类系统进行了分析，并对比了不同系统在策略构建、离线交易、实时市场表现及可靠性评估方面的表现。研究发现，现有系统大多仍侧重于信号发现环节，而与投资组合构建、订单执行及风险控制的全面整合仍较为罕见。尽管工作流程日益多样化，多智能体系统仍高度依赖数据聚合功能。基准测试结果表明，强大的模型或预测能力并不能确保在实时市场环境下带来稳定的交易业绩，也无法有效保障系统的可靠性。最后，我们提出了未来量化交易系统的发展方向，包括实现更完善的业务流程、加强系统间的协调性，以及制定与评估能力相匹配的评估体系。。研究方法：调查数据。

papers.title: Metaorder modelling and identification from public data
papers.abstract: Market-order flow in financial markets exhibits long-range correlations. This is a widely known stylised fact of financial markets. A popular hypothesis for this stylised fact comes from the Lillo-Mike-Farmer (LMF) order-splitting theory. However, quantitative tests of this theory have historically relied on proprietary datasets with trader identifiers, limiting reproducibility and cross-market validation. We investigate whether it can be recovered from anonymous public data using synthetic metaorder reconstruction. Using transaction and quote data for the largest 239 stocks by market capitalisation on the JSE as of 13 March 2026 with the data range being 1 January 2023 until 31 December 2025, we conduct a grid search over reconstruction parameters and evaluate each configuration against established metaorder stylised facts and the LMF relation. Configurations selected to minimise errors across the metaorder impact stylised facts reproduce the targeted aggregate properties but yield a poor LMF relation. Configurations selected to minimise the LMF discrepancy recover the relation by construction while retaining several broad impact features, although some stock-level execution and decay fits are weaker. These asymmetric results show that recovering aggregate impact stylised facts alone is insufficient to identify LMF-consistent order splitting, while the LMF-targeted result establishes compatibility within the reconstruction class rather than an independent test. The findings support consistency with, rather than direct validation of, the LMF theory using anonymous market data.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】金融市场中的市场订单流动表现出长期相关性，这是金融市场的一个广为人知的特征。关于这一特征的一个流行假说源自Lillo-Mike-Farmer（LMF）订单拆分理论。然而，对该理论的定量检验历来依赖于包含交易者标识信息的专有数据集，这限制了研究的可重复性和跨市场验证的可行性。我们探讨了是否可以通过使用合成元订单重构方法从匿名公开数据中恢复这一现象。研究使用了截至2026年3月13日在约翰内斯堡证券交易所（JSE）市值最大的239只股票的交易数据和报价数据，数据覆盖时间为2023年1月1日至2025年12月31日。我们对重构参数进行了网格搜索，并将每种配置与已知的元订单特征及LMF关系进行对比评估。那些旨在最小化元订单特征误差的配置虽然能够再现目标的整体特征，但得到的LMF关系并不理想；而那些旨在最小化LMF差异的配置则在保留了多个关键影响特征的同时成功恢复了LMF关系，尽管某些股票层面的执行过程和衰减规律的拟合效果较弱。这些非对称的结果表明，仅通过恢复整体影响特征不足以识别符合LMF理论的订单拆分行为；而以LMF关系为目标的配置分析更多是在重构方法内部验证了理论的一致性，而非对其进...。

papers.title: Neural Calibration of a Complete Market Model
papers.abstract: We propose a neural calibration method to construct a recombining binomial tree directly from a set of given option prices. Rather than estimating a continuous option pricing function or a local volatility surface as an intermediate object, a neural network is used to deform a benchmark lattice. This leads to a discrete pricing model which is guaranteed to be arbitrage-free, complete, easy to interpret, and can be used directly for pricing and to find replicating trading strategies. Calibration is formulated as a penalized optimization problem that combines a repricing error with an admissibility penalty, and an optional spatial regularization term based on implied local volatilities. Numerical experiments on synthetic and SPX market data show that the proposed approach yields accurate repricing and is very competitive when compared to recently proposed other neural calibration methods. It preserves the computational advantages of lattice-based valuation and hedging. In particular, the calibrated tree can be reused to price contracts that allow early exercise, and could even be calibrated directly with American option prices.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们提出了一种神经校准方法，该方法可以直接从一组给定的期权价格构建重组二项树。该方法不通过估计连续的期权定价函数或局部波动率曲面作为中间步骤，而是利用神经网络对基准格子结构进行变形，从而得到一个离散的定价模型。该模型具有无套利性、完备性，并且易于理解，可直接用于期权定价及复制交易策略的制定。校准过程被构建为一个带有惩罚项的优化问题，其中惩罚项包括重定价误差、可接受性约束，以及基于隐含局部波动率的可选空间正则化项。通过对合成数据和SPX市场数据的数值实验表明，所提出的方法能够实现准确的期权价格重定价，并且在与其他近期提出的神经校准方法相比具有较高的竞争力。该方法保留了基于格子的估值和对冲方法的计算优势；特别是，校准后的二项树可以用于定价允许提前行权的期权合约，甚至可以直接使用美式期权价格进行校准。。研究方法：模型校准、神经网络、实验方法、优化方法。

papers.title: Importance Sampling Enhanced with the COS Method for the Portfolio Risk Allocation
papers.abstract: We introduce ISCOS, a cross-entropy importance-sampling calibration method for rare credit-portfolio losses. We derive Gaussian and Gaussian--inverse-Gamma proposals and analyse the propagation of finite-COS approximation errors to the fitted parameters. Numerical experiments for Gaussian and Student t-copula credit portfolios show the efficiency of this method.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】我们提出了一种名为ISCOS的交叉熵重要性采样校准方法，用于处理罕见信用组合损失问题。该方法构建了高斯分布和逆伽马分布的采样提案，并分析了有限阶COS近似误差对拟合参数的影响。通过对高斯分布和学生t分布copula信用组合的数值实验验证，证明了该方法的有效性。。研究方法：模型校准、实验方法。

papers.title: A note on markets with semi-static trading strategies
papers.abstract: We investigate arbitrage in a discrete-time financial market model where, in addition to finitely many dynamically traded assets, there are also static options to choose from. We introduce the concept of small cones of random variables and present a sufficient condition for the attainable positions in the market to be closed in probability.   A fundamental theorem of asset pricing is shown in the present context. Utility maximization will also be considered. We will provide economically meaningful examples of infinite dimensional small cones to demonstrate the pertinence of our approach.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了一个离散时间金融市场模型中的套利行为。在该模型中，除了有限数量的动态交易资产外，还存在可供选择的静态期权。我们引入了“随机变量小锥”的概念，并提出了一个充分条件，以确保市场中的可达成头寸在概率意义上能够被封闭（即这些头寸的存在是确定的）。在当前的研究背景下，我们验证了一个资产定价的基本定理。同时，我们也会探讨效用最大化问题。为了证明我们方法的相关性，我们将提供一些具有经济意义的多维随机变量小锥的实例。。

papers.title: Rising Income Risk at the Top
papers.abstract: We document an increase in U.S. income risk from 1969 to 2019 using newly digitized IRS tax returns, distinguishing permanent from transitory risk. Since the 1970s, permanent income risk increased across the distribution, but most sharply among high earners, rising nearly 70% among the top 5%. We show that, even among top earners, large negative income shocks strongly predict financial distress and higher income risk is linked with higher savings. In a quantitative life-cycle model, rising income risk concentrated at the top lowers the risk-free rate by 0.7pp, increases wealth inequality, and contributes to the "savings glut of the rich."
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】我们利用新数字化的美国国税局（IRS）纳税申报表，记录了1969年至2019年间美国收入风险的上升趋势，并区分了永久性风险和暂时性风险。自20世纪70年代以来，整个收入分布范围内的永久性收入风险均有所增加，尤其是高收入群体的风险增幅最为显著——最高收入群体的风险上升了近70%。研究发现，即使在高收入群体中，较大的负面收入冲击也会显著增加其财务困境的风险，同时较高的收入风险也与较高的储蓄水平相关。在一个定量生命周期模型中，收入风险的上升主要集中在高收入群体，这导致无风险利率下降了0.7个百分点，加剧了财富不平等现象，并进一步推动了“富人储蓄过剩”的现象。。

papers.title: Tariff Threats, Macroeconomic Expectations, and Policy Communication Strategies: Experiments Based on a Multi-Agent System
papers.abstract: Tariff threats can move household beliefs before policy is enacted, yet their rapidly changing language is difficult to study with conventional surveys. We build a multi-agent system that turns 300 households from the Michigan Surveys of Consumers into persistent large-language-model agents exposed to social-media information over several simulated months. Calibrated agents reproduce some distributional and demographic patterns in human survey data collected after the announcement of Liberation Day tariffs. Simulated experiments indicate that immediacy, rate salience, semantic progression, message complexity, narrative, and sender identity jointly shape inflation and unemployment expectations and their dispersion. Open-ended responses trace these effects to attention, ambiguity, credibility, and causal narratives. A second experiment finds that central-bank explanations can coordinate beliefs, although their effects on average expectations depend on message content. The framework supports disciplined exploration of policy communication, subject to human validation rather than as a substitute for it.
papers.summary_zh: 【国际贸易】关税威胁可能在政策正式实施之前就影响民众的观念，但由于相关表述的快速变化，传统调查方法难以对其进行有效研究。我们构建了一个多智能体系统，将密歇根消费者调查中的300户家庭转化为能够持续接收社交媒体信息的智能体，并模拟这些智能体在数月内的行为。经过校准的智能体能够再现解放日关税宣布后收集到的人类调查数据中的一些分布特征和人口统计模式。模拟实验表明，信息的即时性、表达的显著性、语义的连贯性、信息的复杂性、叙述方式以及信息发送者的身份共同影响了人们对通货膨胀和失业率的预期及其分布情况。开放式调查结果揭示了这些影响背后的机制，包括人们的注意力、信息的模糊性、信息的可信度以及人们构建的因果关系。另一项实验发现，中央银行的解释能够在一定程度上协调民众的观念，不过这些解释对平均预期的影响取决于信息的具体内容。该框架为政策沟通的研究提供了有力工具，但它应作为政策沟通的辅助手段，而非替代方案。。研究方法：模型校准、实验方法、调查数据。

papers.title: Authority-Inference Separation in Agentic Finance: First-Line Control, Blockchain Enforcement, and Replayable Assurance
papers.abstract: AI agents can select tools, counterparties, and transaction parameters, yet inference should not itself confer authority to execute a financial action. This study develops and evaluates Authority-Inference Separation (AIS), an intent-centered architecture for bounded agentic finance. AIS treats a financial action intent as the control object: a machine-generated proposal can receive temporary executable authority only after an independent deterministic control plane validates registered agent identity, accountable ownership, mandate and risk-appetite lineage, policy version, state, approvals, and exact economic semantics. Blockchain can then enforce the operational representation of granted authority and record portable settlement evidence, while institutional legitimacy, service delivery, accounting classification, and human accountability remain off-chain obligations. Evaluation combines four-domain instantiation, official BIS and MAS cases, a 48-fixture executable prototype, and a public-ledger observability test. Across 36 synthetic authorization attacks, a direct-agent baseline accepted 36 attack effects, a prompt-policy baseline accepted 20, and AIS accepted none; all three accepted 8/8 admissible fixtures. AIS also rejected 4/4 token replays and 8/8 recipient or rail substitutions, withheld completion in 4/4 service-delivery failures, and populated all 13 defined evidence fields. A test of 1,700 recent Base transactions associated with public x402 facilitator addresses shows that public ledgers can evidence settlement and selected authorization parameters but cannot establish institutional mandate, legal accountability, service delivery, or accounting treatment. AIS and blockchain are therefore complementary: AIS decides whether a specific intent may act, while blockchain can make granted authority bounded, executable, and independently observable.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融科技】人工智能代理能够选择工具、交易对手及交易参数，但推理过程本身不应赋予其执行金融操作的权限。本研究提出并评估了一种名为“权限-推理分离”（Authority-Inference Separation, AIS）的架构，该架构专为有限权限的代理金融系统设计。AIS将金融操作意图视为控制对象：只有当独立的确定性控制机制验证了代理的身份、所有权的合法性、授权与风险承受能力、政策版本、系统状态、相关审批信息以及精确的经济语义后，机器生成的提案才能获得临时执行权限。区块链可用于执行授权操作并记录可迁移的结算证据，而机构合法性、服务提供、会计分类以及人类责任等要素则由链外机制负责处理。评估内容包括四个领域的实际应用案例、国际清算银行（BIS）与多主体系统（MAS）的官方标准、一个包含48个测试用例的可执行原型，以及基于公共账本的透明度测试。在36次模拟授权攻击中，直接代理模型对所有攻击均无抵抗能力；提示式策略模型仅能抵御20次攻击；而AIS模型成功抵御了所有攻击。此外，AIS模型还拒绝了所有4次代币重放尝试、8次接收方或交易流程的篡改行为，在4次服务提供失败情况下中止了操作，并完整填充了所有1...。
